independent_reference.method: Exact rational arithmetic over retained closes; 60-digit Decimal square root only for sample dispersion
independent_reference.alignment_convention: signal at i, execution at i+1, label end at i+2

research_quality_findings.finding: The reviewer and supervisor call the original one-observation forward labels overlapping. Adjacent label intervals share an endpoint but have zero positive overlap; serial dependence is a separate untested question. Overlap handling can matter for the later generic horizon greater than one.

The draft calls failure to reject the null disconfirmation of the proposed effect. It needs a distinct inconclusive outcome and a pre-specified uncertainty/power or equivalence criterion, rather than treating non-significance as proof of absence.

The draft offers alternative thresholds and tests and leaves threshold, minimum bucket size, significance level, effect margin and horizon unresolved. It is a research sketch, not an executable factor contract.
